name: Resting Place of Mars
description: A regio on the plains of Lombardy about 10 miles northwest of Milan, possibly the tomb of a sleeping war deity; its aura increases warlike and decreases peaceful Personality Traits.

name: Old Ones
description: Ancient beings of enormous power whose civilization was destroyed by Tarhutis; they fled to human lands, were worshipped as gods, and now sleep in hidden places.

name: Seekers
description: Members of the Order who search for the sleeping Old Ones and their ancient lore, hoping to take their power.

name: Tarhutis
description: The one said to have destroyed the civilization of the Old Ones millennia ago.

name: Mars
description: The Roman war deity; the Resting Place of Mars is speculated to be the sleeping place of such a war god.

name: Luctatio
description: A covenant whose magi came to Lombardy in 1162 and built on the Resting Place of Mars, until an army destroyed its foundation and they moved closer to Milan.

name: Lombardy
description: Region of northern Italy whose plains hold the Resting Place of Mars and which has been plagued by unrest for a millennium.

name: Milan
description: Northern Italian city near the Resting Place of Mars, marched upon by a great army.

name: Italy
description: The Italian peninsula, the territory of the Roman Tribunal, full of constant battles and politicking.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: The Tribunal of the Order of Hermes covering Italy; one of the oldest Tribunals.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural layered area whose 'upper' levels can be entered from the mundane level; the Resting Place of Mars has a Magical level ranked five and Saint Aquila a Divine level ranked seven.

name: Magical Regio
description: The Magical upper level of the Resting Place of Mars regio (level 5), containing a stone block and a tomb full of weapons.

name: Divine Regio
description: The Divine level (7) covering the Church of Saint Aquila, where those in prayer find absolute peace and those who reject Christ feel dread.

name: Aura
description: A supernatural emotional aura around the Resting Place of Mars that alters Personality Traits and Passions.

name: Personality Traits
description: Character traits such as Brave or Arrogant, modified by the aura of the Resting Place of Mars.

name: Passions
description: Strong character emotions treated like Personality Traits for the aura effects of the Resting Place of Mars.

name: Mount Olympus
description: One of the places where the Old Ones are said to sleep.

name: Tertius Quid
description: A forest where the Old Ones are said to sleep.

name: Stonehenge
description: Said by some to be a sleeping place of the Old Ones.

name: Infamitus
description: Arch-Mage quoted on the Old Ones, author of The True Origins of the Magical Traditions.

name: The True Origins of the Magical Traditions
description: A text by Arch-Mage Infamitus discussing the sleeping Old Ones.

name: Weapons of the Resting Place of Mars
description: Magnificent weapons lining the tomb walls; each gives +3 damage and +2 First Strike and Attack, shifts Personality Traits toward war, and brings a ghostly swordsman upon the taker.

name: Sarcophagus of the Resting Place of Mars
description: A huge empty sarcophagus for a being 50 feet tall in the tomb's center; any damage to it repairs on the next new moon.

name: Ghostly Swordsman
description: Insubstantial warriors in full chain with great swords who attack anyone who takes a weapon from the Resting Place of Mars at the next new moon, until defeated or the weapon is returned.

name: The Dark
description: A malevolent force that might have set the Resting Place of Mars as a trap to gather souls.

name: Church of Saint Aquila
description: A small, poor romanesque church in eastern Rome near the Porta Salaria built on the home of Saint Aquila, covered by a Divine regio.

name: Saint Aquila
description: A first-century Jewish tentmaker converted by Saint Paul in Corinth whose Roman house became a church; he and his wife were martyred.

name: Saint Paul
description: Converted Aquila and his wife to Christianity in Corinth.

name: Emperor Claudius
description: Roman emperor who expelled all Jews from Rome.

name: Corinth
description: City where Aquila and his wife were converted by Saint Paul.

name: Rome
description: City containing the Church of Saint Aquila; home of the Roman Scribe vocation.

name: Porta Salaria
description: Gate on the eastern side of Rome near the Church of Saint Aquila.

name: Angelo
description: The old priest of Saint Aquila for 40 years, who has received visions and moves between the mundane and Divine regio.

name: Divine
description: The Divine realm, manifest in the regio of Saint Aquila and able to bring divine wrath.

name: Magic Realm
description: The magical realm whose regio lies over the Resting Place of Mars.

name: Vocation
description: Character templates representing peoples and professions; here specific to the Roman Tribunal.

name: Saga
description: The ongoing campaign that discoveries like the Resting Place of Mars can alter.

name: Storyguide
description: The game master who decides mantra bonuses and the truth of mysteries.

name: Grog
description: Covenant warriors and servants; grog vocations include Gang Member and Italian Sailor.

name: Custos
description: Trusted covenant guard status to which grogs aspire.

name: Companion
description: Non-magus player characters; companion vocations include Bologna Scholar and Covenant Ship Captain.

name: Magus
description: A Hermetic wizard of the Order; magus vocations are given for several Houses.

name: Gang Member
description: Grog vocation: a northern Italian city gang youth now serving magi as a warrior.

name: Italian Sailor
description: Grog vocation: a fisherman's son who sailed Venetian merchant ships and now serves on a magi-owned ship.

name: Lombard Warrior
description: Grog vocation: a mercenary from Lombardy serving a covenant's magi.

name: Messenger
description: Grog vocation: carries messages between a covenant and its interests across Italy.

name: Venetian Thief
description: Grog vocation: a Venice street thief fleeing after a killing.

name: Bologna Scholar
description: Companion vocation: a University of Bologna student taught about the Order by the magi of Literatus.

name: Covenant Ship Captain
description: Companion vocation: captain of a covenant's ship who smuggles on the side.

name: Roman Scribe
description: Companion vocation: a scribe's second son from Rome copying magical documents for magi.

name: Rebellious Son
description: Companion vocation: a northern noble family's son turned sellsword.

name: Venetian Spy
description: Companion vocation: a Venetian spy selling secrets to the highest bidder.

name: Commune Mercenary
description: Magus vocation (Tytalus) who hires out to Italian communes, using subtle self-enhancing magic in battle.

name: Independent Rebel
description: Magus vocation (Tremere) seeking vengeance on the Roman Tribunal for his master.

name: Literatus Student
description: Magus vocation (Jerbiton) trained at Literatus and the University of Bologna.

name: Necromancer
description: Magus vocation (Ex Miscellanea) trained in the catacombs of Vardian's Tomb in necromancy.

name: Magic Item Merchant
description: Magus vocation (Verditius) from Verdi who sells magic items to nobles.

name: Vardian's Tomb
description: A covenant with catacombs where necromancy is taught, home to bickering Jerbiton.

name: University of Bologna
description: University in Bologna near Literatus where students and apprentices learn mundane learning.

name: Bologna
description: Italian city home to the University of Bologna.

name: Literatus
description: One of the most scholarly covenants in the Order, near the University of Bologna.

name: Verdi
description: Covenant where wealth is valued; it has a townhouse in Venice.

name: Venice
description: City of intrigue and merchant ships, home of thieves and spies.

name: Steris
description: A magus seen in Verdi's townhouse in a scandal reported by a Venetian spy.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi.

name: The Gift
description: The inborn capacity for Hermetic magic.

name: Church
description: The Christian Church.

name: Communes
description: Italian city communes that hire mercenaries.

name: Necromancy

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power used in enchanting items.

name: Season
